question: Why is ertapenem short, and what do we do?

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's foreign-key rules over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 12 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug.

steps.title: What we decided last time
steps.purpose: Recall past decisions on this drug from H-MEM, with who approved them.
steps.finding: No past decisions on this drug.

sentences.text: FDA inspection 955350 of ACS Dobfar S.p.A. (FEI 3006028606) ended on 2016-01-19 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2016-04-18.
The plant was later inspected on 2017-07-21 (VAI), 2018-04-13 (VAI), 2022-04-08 (VAI), and 2024-12-13 (VAI).
A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2017-01-13.
Corvale East holds 448 units at 14.9 units per day, providing 30 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 723 units at 33.2 units per day, providing 22 days on hand.

Q-0be9c9.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%ertapenem%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%ertapenem%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-99ad2b.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('178a0356-4f6c-47fb-9913-f325a3c72f7b', 'cf3cfa6b-211c-452b-b18b-e462b21e6909') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-77e908.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%ertapenem%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-de254b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%ertapenem%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-43165f.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%ertapenem%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f2aaaf.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3006028606') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-9f9ebd.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3006028606') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-1192ed.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3006028606') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('acs dobfar')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-77f65a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('acs dobfar', 'hospira', 'wg critical care') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%ertapenem%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-4aec48.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('955350') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-c48cb6.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00409351022', '44567082010')

Q-a4ce9e.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%ertapenem%'
